script: pre-registration recorded before running the repair_v5 chain
change: ANCHOR_PRIOR_MODE=kriging.  The anchor prior MEAN is now a simple-kriging estimate using the already-fitted exponential variogram, instead of the plain median of the 8 nearest anchors.  The prior WIDTH is unchanged.  No new parameter is introduced: the correlation range (0.853 deg) and sill (1.228 mag) were fitted in repair_v3 and are reused as-is.
motivation: The plain median gives distant anchors full weight while prior_sigma_at simultaneously widens the same star's uncertainty to near the sill, i.e. declares those anchors nearly uninformative.  The prior's first and second moments contradict each other.  Kriging removes the contradiction.
not_tuned: The size of the correction is fixed by the fitted variogram and each star's anchor geometry; nothing was adjusted to make any gate pass.  Independent evidence that the correction points the right way: both 3D dust cubes rank CygOB2-B as the LEAST extinguished subgroup (Vergely 3.378 vs A 3.685, C 3.763; Dharmawardena 1.200 vs 1.371, 1.278) while the uncorrected prior ranks it the MOST extinguished.

predictions.statement: CygOB2-B's median fitted A_V falls by 0.2-0.5 mag
predictions.falsifies_if: B's A_V moves by less than 0.1 mag or rises

predictions.statement: CygOB2-B's fitted upper-main-sequence age RISES above its repair_v3 value of 2.818 Myr
predictions.falsifies_if: B's age stays within 0.1 Myr of 2.818 or falls
predictions.note: less extinction -> intrinsically fainter stars -> older isochrone

predictions.statement: CygOB2-A and CygOB2-C ages and extinctions are essentially unchanged (A within 0.05 mag, C within 0.15 mag)
predictions.falsifies_if: A or C moves more than that, which would mean the change is not B-specific

predictions.statement: the WP5 residual tilt for B flattens (replacement trend statistic |T| falls below 2)
predictions.note: tested only in stage B, after the full chain
predictions.falsifies_if: |T| stays above 2 with the corrected extinction

interpretation_rule: If P1-P3 hold but P4 fails, the extinction error is real but is NOT the cause of B's mass-function tilt, and CygOB2-B being a genuinely distinct population returns as the leading hypothesis.  That outcome will be reported as such, not worked around.
